name: ZCQ_CONFIGURATIONS
description: ZCQ_CONFIGURATIONS table stores the various configurations for each data quality entity along with the match option and the data quality server used got this configuration. This table stores both matching and cleansing configurations

columns.name: CONFIGURATION_CODE
columns.description: CONFIGURATION_CODE

columns.name: CONFIGURATION_NAME
columns.description: CONFIGURATION_NAME

columns.name: CONFIGURATION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: CONFIGURATION_DESCRIPTION

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: ENTITY_CODE

columns.name: SERVER_OPERATION_ID
columns.description: SERVER_OPERATION_ID

columns.name: OPTION_CODE
columns.description: OPTION_CODE

columns.name: CONFIG_TYPE
columns.description: CONFIG_TYPE

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: DEFAULT_RT_FLAG

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG_BT
columns.description: DEFAULT_BT_FLAG

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Decide if the configuration is enabled

columns.name: READY_FLAG
columns.description: Decide if the configuration is ready to use

columns.name: VALID_FLAG
columns.description: Decide if the configuration is valid

columns.name: STATUS_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Message Code

columns.name: STATUS_TIMESTAMP_TOKEN
columns.description: Timestamp of message token

columns.name: STATUS_UPDATE_TIME
columns.description: The timestamp of updating status fields

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ESS Job request ID

columns.name: STATUS_NUMBER_TOKEN
columns.description: STATUS_NUMBER_TOKEN

columns.name: ENGINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of match scoring engine. e.g. EDQ or Custom Scoring.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CANDIDATE_SQL
columns.description: Candidate SQL to load up the TCA data for this mapping.

columns.name: BATCH_ENGINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of scoring engine for batch match - EDQ or Custom Scoring.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
